method: Compare computed dimensions (2px tolerance), font, text, colors and display of headings, paragraphs, images, summaries and shared header/footer against the same HTML with original unpruned CSS. Both modes served locally; baseline disables hydration to retain original stylesheet links.
limitations: Comparison covers sampled element properties, not a pixel-by-pixel guarantee or all possible interaction states.
comparisonPhase: CSS consolidation before the subsequent intentional visual corrections
intentionalCorrections: Removed obsolete Elementor lazy-background blocking rules; background images/gradients now render without WordPress JavaScript.
Replaced quote-page empty Elementor columns/shortcode remnants with a compact native introduction, preserving the original heading and description.
Improved caption, pricing-note, post-navigation and WhatsApp-link contrast.
